LanguageData.Spatialist.CloseGateDesc: Close this pocket gate. Anyone inside the pocket is skipped out next to it. The pocket and its contents remain.
LanguageData.Spatialist.PocketMissing: This gate isn't connected to a pocket.
LanguageData.Spatialist.GateBlocked: The gate needs an open, visible spot with no buildings.
LanguageData.Spatialist.NeedMap: Can only be cast on a map.
LanguageData.Spatialist.CantOpenInPocket: Can't open a gate from inside a pocket map.
LanguageData.Spatialist.EvacuateConfirm: The gate is closed, and a gate can't be opened from inside the pocket.\n\nSkip everyone in {0}'s pocket out to the nearest colony map?
LanguageData.Spatialist.NowhereToGo: There is no map to skip out to.
LanguageData.Spatialist.NoPocketYet: The caster has no pocket dimension yet. Cast Pocket Gate first.
LanguageData.Spatialist.MustBeOutside: Must be cast from outside a pocket map.
LanguageData.Spatialist.GateClosedNoWayOut: Inside the pocket, items can only be skipped out through an open gate. Open the gate first.
LanguageData.Spatialist.AlreadyInPocket: The caster is already inside their own pocket.
LanguageData.Spatialist.NotStashable: Only loose items can be stashed.
LanguageData.Spatialist.PocketMaxed: This pocket can't grow any further.
LanguageData.Spatialist.CollapsedText: With {0} gone, their pocket dimension has collapsed. Everything that was inside has spilled out.
